dct_title_s: Geologic map of the Beverly Hills and Van Nuys (South 1/2) Quadrangles, Los Angeles County, California
dct_description_sm: Prepared in cooperation with the California Department of Conservation Division of Mines and Geology, and U.S. Geological Survey.
